subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this durable runtime, shared schema, protocol, CLI, and environment-variable surface as a supported beta foundation?
rationale: The upstream RFC remains open for human direction, and this PR establishes a broad persistent cross-owner contract that implementation correctness alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor durable beta
options.body: Accept this opt-in foundation and complete source-of-truth, upgrade, rollback, and ownership review before merge.

options.title: Narrow the foundation
options.body: Retain only approved internal persistence primitives and defer the public CLI, protocol, recovery, and broad lifecycle integrations.

options.title: Do not adopt
options.body: Close the stack and improve existing task, subagent, delivery, and session owners without adding a cross-owner durability projection.

recommendation.title: Sponsor durable beta
recommendation.body: Accept this opt-in foundation and complete source-of-truth, upgrade, rollback, and ownership review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS and current-main history connect this handle to the broadest set of runtime and state boundaries affected by the product choice.
